title: LLM智能体利用仿真模型进行受控实验
summary: 提出一种多智能体框架，使LLM智能体能够结合科学仿真模型进行受控实验，用于制药工艺设计。系统构建任务表示、设计实验、执行比较仿真、解释结果并生成基于证据的参数优化建议，输出比纯语言推理更具体、可操作，在工业应用中提升了正确性和有用性。
summary_en: Proposes a multi-agent framework enabling LLM agents to conduct controlled experiments with scientific simulation models for pharmaceutical process design, producing more specific and actionable outputs than language-only reasoning, with improved correctness and helpfulness in industrial settings.
